_readme: AI roster and table talk. Edit freely: names, taglines, colors, lines. Style knobs: knockAlwaysAt/knockMaybeAt (points), raiseAppetite (x chance), foldChance (0-1, how readily they fold a bad hand to a raise), takesLowDiscards. Event keys (sufferTonk = the player won big with a tonk or knock): greet, knockWin, knockCaught, catchKnocker, tonk, sufferTonk, spread, hitYou, gotHit, raise, callRaise, passRaise (= fold), matchWin, matchLose. {you} is replaced with the player's name.

greet: Shuffle up, I got all night.
Pull up a chair, nephew. Class is in session.
knockWin: Knock knock. Who's there? The winner.
knockCaught: Hold on now, them cards was lying to me.
That one don't count, I sneezed.
catchKnocker: You knocked on the wrong door!
sufferTonk: Who taught you that? Oh right. Me.
Lucky. Pure luck. Write that down.
spread: Look at that spread. Like a Sunday buffet.
That's how the old heads do it.
hitYou: Thank you kindly for the spot.
I'm just gonna park this right here.
gotHit: Oh you hitting my spread now? Bold.
callRaise: I'll see that and raise my eyebrows.
raise: Let me make this interesting. Raise!
passRaise: I'm out. Saving mine for the next plate.
matchLose: I let you have that one. Family discount.

characters.name: Aunt Dot
characters.tagline: Runs the table. Runs the kitchen. Runs everything.

knockWin: Mm-hm. I knew it before you did.
Baby, I've been knocking since before you were born.
tonk: Tonk. Now wash your hands, dinner's ready.
And that's how it's done in this house.
sufferTonk: Okay, I see you. Don't let it go to your head.
spread: Set the table, set the spread.
hitYou: I'll be taking that, thank you.
What's yours is mine in this house.
gotHit: Did I say you could touch that?
callRaise: You can't scare me, I raised six kids.
raise: Put some money on it, baby.
matchLose: Fine. But you're doing the dishes.

characters.name: Cousin Dre
characters.tagline: Quiet. Knocks early. Way too early.

characters.name: Mr. Earl
characters.tagline: Old school. Slow. Patient as a fishing trip.

greet: Take your time. I got nowhere to be.
Back in my day we played for pennies.
catchKnocker: Slow down. The cards ain't going nowhere.
tonk: Well, would you look at that.
Took my time and took the pot.
sufferTonk: You remind me of me, forty years ago.
spread: Laying them down nice and easy.
raise: A little something for the pot.
matchLose: Good game. Now help me up.

characters.name: Keisha
characters.tagline: Spread queen. Grabs every card you throw away.

knockCaught: We are not talking about this.
sufferTonk: I was about to do that.
spread: Look at my spread. Look at it.
hitYou: You built it, I decorated it.
callRaise: Put it in the pot, I'll take it out later.
passRaise: I fold. I'm on a budget this week.

hitYou: Thanks for the free spot, unc.
callRaise: You can't scare me with that.

characters.name: Grandma Pearl
characters.tagline: Sweetest lady you know. Ruthless at the table.

greet: I brought cookies. And a strategy.
knockWin: Oh my, would you look at that.
knockCaught: Oh dear. My eyes aren't what they used to be.
catchKnocker: Sweetie, I could see that from here.
tonk: Grandma wins again. Don't tell your mother.
sufferTonk: I'm so proud of you. Never do that again.
spread: Just like knitting. One row at a time.
gotHit: Bold. I like it. Still mad though.
raise: Let's make it worth my while.
matchWin: Now come give Grandma a hug.
matchLose: I let you win. Grandmas do that.

knockCaught: Okay, that didn't go how I planned.
